scalars.scalar_value: Two (2) years of experience working with children birth to five years.

items.item_text: Current CPR and First Aid training.
Two (2) years of experience working with children birth to five years.

Prepares classroom setting; maintains safety and educational programs; supervises children in the classroom, outdoor play periods and nap time; provides a supportive environment in which children can learn and practice appropriate and acceptable individual and group behaviors in compliance with licensing regulations.

Organizes and prepares developmentally appropriate early childhood education programs; plans and implements curriculum and education for children ranging in age from six weeks to five years old. Provides activities and opportunities that encourage curiosity, exploration, language, problem solving, and physical skills appropriate to the developmental levels and learning styles of children.

Creates a team work environment with other teaching staff to facilitate children’s learning. Writes and compiles individual assessments of each child’s development; completes daily inventories, child attendance, and related reports. Document children’s work by creating children’s binders.

Maintains open and cooperative communication with parents and families, participates in home visits and parent-teacher conferences; encourages parent involvement in the program and supports the child’s family relationships.
Supervises, volunteers in the classroom. Models expert teaching practices.
Demonstrates behaviors in concert with hospital mission, vision, values, policies & procedures.
BA in Child Development or a minimum of 24 Child Development units.
California Department of Education Teacher Permit.
